sections.title: route_solution(), validate_config_solution(), json_query_solution()
sections.body:
```python
# SOLUTION 1
def route_solution(method, path):
    parts = path.strip('/').split('/')
    match (method, parts):
        case ("GET", ["users"]):
            return "List users"
        case ("GET", ["users", user_id]):
            return f"Get user {user_id}"
        case ("POST", ["users"]):
            return "Create user"
        case ("PUT", ["users", user_id]):
            return f"Update user {user_id}"
        case ("DELETE", ["users", user_id]):
            return f"Delete user {user_id}"
        case _:
            return "404 Not Found"

# SOLUTION 2
def validate_config_solution(config):
    match config:
        case {"type": "dev", "debug": True}:
            return (True, "Valid dev config")
        case {"type": "prod", "debug": False, "replicas": int(r)} if r > 0:
            return (True, f"Valid prod config with {r} replicas")
        case {"type": "test", "debug": True, "mock": bool()}:
            return (True, "Valid test config")
        case _:
            return (False, "Invalid configuration")

# SOLUTION 3
def json_query_solution(data, query):
    match query:
        case ["get", key]:
            return data.get(key)
        case ["set", key, value]:
            data[key] = value
            return value
        case ["delete", key]:
            return data.pop(key, None)
        case ["has", key]:
            return key in data
        case ["keys"]:
            return list(data.keys())
        case _:
            return None
```

sections.body:
```python
# SOLUTION 4
def evaluate_solution(expr):
    match expr:
        case int(n) | float(n):
            return n
        case ["add", left, right]:
            return evaluate_solution(left) + evaluate_solution(right)
        case ["sub", left, right]:
            return evaluate_solution(left) - evaluate_solution(right)
        case ["mul", left, right]:
            return evaluate_solution(left) * evaluate_solution(right)
        case ["div", left, right]:
            return evaluate_solution(left) / evaluate_solution(right)
        case _:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown expression: {expr}")

# SOLUTION 5
def dispatch_event_solution(event):
    match event:
        case {"type": "click", "x": x, "y": y, "button": button}:
            return f"Click at ({x}, {y}) with {button} button"
        case {"type": "keypress", "key": key, "modifiers": mods}:
            mod_str = "+".join(mods) if mods else ""
            return f"Key pressed: {mod_str}+{key}" if mod_str else f"Key pressed: {key}"
        case {"type": "mouse_move", "x": x, "y": y}:
            return f"Mouse moved to ({x}, {y})"
        case {"type": "scroll", "delta": delta}:
            direction = "down" if delta > 0 else "up"
            return f"Scrolled {direction} by {abs(delta)}"
        case _:
            return "Unknown event"
```
